subject: Q3 renewal: stepped-term conversion + top-up runway
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@lightsailhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lightsail Health Procurement <procurement@lightsailhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 renewal: stepped-term conversion + top-up runway

Vanessa,

Hope you had a good weekend. We're coming up on our July renewal and the leadership team wants to explore converting our current 12-month plan into a stepped/multi-year structure to lock in better unit pricing while keeping flexibility for variable usage. A few priorities from our side: 

- We expect a 40-70% capacity increase over the next 12 months due to two pilots ramping.
- We'd like a scheduled top-up window each quarter (a 72-hour window) to add burst capacity without renegotiating the whole contract.
- Auto-renew is fine but procurement needs an explicit opt-out window and a short notice period for price changes.
- Any pricing credit for upfront commit or multi-year would be helpful.

Can you send a simple structure we can review (term lengths, ramp schedule, top-up cadence, and an example pricing worksheet)? If possible we'd like a draft we can circulate to procurement/legal and have a signing-ready DocuSign link the week of 4/29.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

Samira Khan
Director, Cloud Programs
Lightsail Health

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@lightsailhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal: stepped-term conversion + top-up runway

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear priorities. High level proposal below; attaching a one-page proposal and the pricing worksheet for visibility.

Proposal (summary):
- Term: 24-month stepped term (24 months total) with pricing tiers that ratchet down at 12 and 18 months if commit thresholds are met.
- Ramp schedule: Quarterly committed capacity targets (Q3->Q4->Q1) tied to stepped discounts. Example: 0-50T tokens baseline, Q4 +30% commit -> 5% unit discount at 12 months, 10% at 18 months if ramp achieved.
- Top-up windows: One scheduled 72-hour top-up per fiscal quarter for burst purchases that are invoiced and applied to the next quarter's commit. Top-ups are allowed up to 30% of active commit without renegotiation.
- Auto-renew: Default auto-renew on anniversary; procurement opt-out window = 45 days prior to renewal; price adjustment notice = 30 days. We can amend to 60 days if Lightsail needs it for internal approvals.
- Prepay/discounts: 3% additional discount for a 6-month prepay on committed capacity; 6% for annual prepay.
- SLO credits: If 99.9% availability SLA missed in a quarter, apply service credits that can be applied against next quarter invoice or as a one-time credit.

Attachments: Lightsail_Renewal_Proposal_20280422.pdf (summary), Pricing_Worksheet_LSH_v3.xlsx (example burn scenarios), REDWOOD-SOW-LSH-draft.docx (SOW placeholder).

Next steps:
1) If this high-level structure looks ok, I'll ask Sales Ops to finalize pricing tiers and legal to fold the opt-out language into the DocuSign-ready amendment.
2) We can offer a 30-minute review with your procurement + legal next Tue (4/24) or Thu (4/26).

Are there any non-negotiable procurement clauses we should be aware of up front?

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0127
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 13:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Q3 renewal: stepped-term conversion + top-up runway

Team — forwarding Lightsail's ask and my high-level. Need quick alignment on two items so I can get a DocuSign draft by the end of next week: 

Action items:
- Karthik: confirm the stepped discount bands we can offer for LSH given their expected ramp (they're targeting ~50-70% increase over 12 months). Include any prepay rounding rules and whether we can allow top-ups to be converted into committed spend mid-quarter. Please attach the final pricing worksheet.
- Marissa: finance sign-off on the billing cadence for top-ups (invoice timing, tax handling), and confirm if we need an escrow/offset for large top-ups > $250k.
- Legal placeholder: we may need to tweak auto-renew notice from 45 -> 60 days if procurement pushes back. Also confirm acceptable wording for a 72-hour top-up window and that we can cap one-top-up-per-quarter without triggering amendment.

Timeline: procurement wants to circulate internally the week of 4/29; preferred signing window is the first week of May. Can you both review and reply by EOD tomorrow so I can incorporate?

Thanks — vanessa

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Q3 renewal: stepped-term conversion + top-up runway

Vanessa — thanks for the context. Quick answers: 

- Discount bands: For a 24-month stepped structure we can offer 4% at 12 months (if 30% uplift realized), 8% at 18 months (if 50% uplift realized). If they prepay annually we can add +2% on top of those bands.
- Top-ups: We can accept top-ups convertible into committed spend mid-quarter, provided the customer notifies finance within 7 days of the top-up so we can apply pro-rated commit. For top-ups > $250k, finance will require an approval/offset; Marissa, please confirm the exact threshold/process.
- Auto-renew language: recommend 60-day opt-out for enterprise procurement; we can keep a 30-day price-change notice if we provide a cap on year-over-year increase (max 7%).

I've attached the updated pricing worksheet (Pricing_Worksheet_LSH_v3.xlsx) with the band math and a sample invoice schedule.

Deal metadata: deal_id LSH-2028-Q3-0422, region US, ARR impact estimate $1.2M first 12 months if uplift achieved.

Karthik
Head of Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.k@lightsailhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Lightsail Health Procurement <procurement@lightsailhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Apr 2028 17:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 renewal: stepped-term conversion + top-up runway

Vanessa — this looks good and addresses the majority of our asks. A couple quick points before we escalate to legal/procurement: 

> Top-ups: We can accept top-ups convertible into committed spend mid-quarter, provided the customer notifies finance within 7 days of the top-up so we can apply pro-rated commit.

Would we be able to get visibility into how that pro-rate will be shown on the invoice? Procurement wants the line itemization to be explicit ("Q3 top-up applied to Q4 commit - prorated at X"). If you can show an invoice example that would help.

Also, the 60-day opt-out is ok for us but procurement asks that the first renewal cycle includes a one-time extension window of 7 days in case our board needs extra time (i.e., a 67-day notice window for the first renewal only). Is that feasible?

If you can send the DocuSign-ready amendment with the requested opt-out language and an illustrative invoice snippet, procurement will review and aim to turn around redlines quickly. We can schedule a 30-minute sync Tue 4/24 11am PT to walk your team through their internal questions.

Thanks — Samira
Director, Cloud Programs
Lightsail Health
